anchor_population: initial Codex selected anchors; later review not used to change fitting population
corner_correspondence: minimum sum one-to-one assignment per anchor at each candidate transform
m4_counts: RoMa pairs = 8 times anchor count; corner pairs = same
objective: unweighted sum of unsquared 3D Euclidean distances
transform: Shot3 to Shot1; positive scale [0.1,10], gravity yaw, xyz translation
timing: actual incremental plus reconstructed no-cache alignment path with recorded RoMa time; source Study2 GPU, Study3 CPU; no cross-device speed ranking
